title: feat(2d): place typed text as single-line engraving strokes (InsertText, MCP insert_text)
body:
First slice of #2679. This PR does not close the issue.

## What changed

- `crates/geometry/src/stroke_text/` is new. It holds our own single-line engraving font and the layout of a typed string.
  - `glyphs.rs` is the glyph table: capital letters, digits, the space and `- _ . : / # + = ( )`. Each glyph is straight strokes on a 4 x 6 grid.
  - `mod.rs` has `strokes()` (polylines in mm) and `sketch()` (a `SketchData` on the layer `text`).
- `crates/app/src/commands/insert_text.rs` is new. `InsertText` is an undoable command. It places the typed text as a `Sketch` on the top face of the stock of a setup, at X, Y and an angle.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/sketch_tools.rs` has the new MCP tool `insert_text`. It calls `InsertText`.
- `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` lists the tool.
- `docs/decisions/2679-engrave-typed-text.md` records the decisions.

The text profile is the same entity as a DXF profile. `move_dxf_profile`, `DeleteEntity`, `get_job` and the project file work on it with no change. The project file format does not change.

## Cause

There was no way to make 2D geometry from typed text. A user had to draw the letters in a CAD program and import a DXF file.

Two facts of `main` set the scope of this slice:

1. The issue says to use a font from `assets/ui/fonts/`. The repository holds no font file. The outlines of the `egui` default fonts need a font parser as a new dependency. A new dependency waits for the maintainer. This PR uses our own stroke font, drawn from scratch. A single-line stroke is also the correct input for the centreline Engrave generator: it gives a solid mark, not a hollow letter.
2. On `main`, an operation on a profile refuses generation by name ("a toolpath from the chains of a DXF profile is not generated yet"). #1869 adds Engrave and Trace on sketch chains, and #1869 depends on #1864 (PR #2716). The toolpath, the verify and the golden CL of #2679 need #1869.

## Refusals by name

- An empty text.
- A character with no glyph. A lower-case letter is refused. It is not changed to a capital, because a silent change puts a wrong mark on a part.
- A cap height outside 0.5 mm to 1000 mm. A letter spacing outside 0 mm to 1000 mm. More than 256 characters.
- A placement that is not finite or is more than 1e6 mm from the stock origin.
- A setup that does not exist. A setup with no stock. A name in use or a reserved name.
- `stroke_text::sketch` fails if a stroke does not chain clean. A text profile cannot hold a rejected chain.

## Tests

Pins (red before the change: the test files did not compile, `unresolved import camcraft_geometry::stroke_text`):

- `crates/geometry/tests/stroke_text.rs`
  - `a_known_string_gives_its_golden_strokes` (golden strokes of `SN-0471`)
  - `each_glyph_chains_with_no_rejection_at_the_extreme_heights`
  - `the_whole_character_set_in_one_string_chains_clean`
  - `the_sketch_is_in_millimetres_on_one_layer_with_the_cap_height_stated`
  - `height_scales_and_letter_spacing_moves_only_the_later_glyphs`
  - `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`
- `crates/geometry/src/stroke_text/mod.rs`: `the_character_set_is_the_glyph_table`, `each_glyph_stays_in_its_box`
- `crates/app/tests/insert_text.rs`
  - `typed_text_lands_as_a_placed_profile_and_undoes`
  - `bad_text_and_bad_places_are_refused_by_name_and_nothing_lands`
  - `a_text_profile_saves_and_loads_with_its_strokes_and_place`
  - `the_mcp_tool_places_text_reports_it_and_takes_an_engrave_operation`

Mutations (each guard removed, the pin run, the guard restored):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `Y` drawn with three stroke ends at one corner | red: `each_glyph_chains_...`, `the_whole_character_set_...` ("3 curve ends meet ... a chain cannot branch") |
| Height check removed in `strokes()` | red: `bad_input_is_refused_by_name` |
| Letter spacing check removed | red: `bad_input_is_refused_by_name` |
| Length check removed | red: `bad_input_is_refused_by_name` |
| Empty-text check removed in `strokes()` | green at first, so the pin was made stricter; then red: `bad_input_is_refused_by_name` (`Ok([])` in place of `Err(Empty)`) |
| No-stock check removed in `InsertText` | red: `bad_text_and_bad_places_...`, `the_mcp_tool_places_text_...` |
| Finite-placement check removed | red: `bad_text_and_bad_places_...` |
| Placement range check removed | red: `bad_text_and_bad_places_...` |
| Reserved-name check removed | red: `bad_text_and_bad_places_...` |

With all guards restored, all pins are green.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green. The change touches the shared crate `camcraft-geometry`, so the quick tier ran as the batch tier.

- Run 1: build, geometry (with `stroke_text`), kernel, cl, tools, post and sim suites: 227 steps ok. The worker tool stopped this run at its time limit in step 228 (`motion suites: lib`). It was not a test failure.
- Run 2 (`--only "motion suites" --only "app suites" --only "ui suites" --only "clippy"`): 709 steps, 0 failed, 53.4 min. `clippy -D warnings` with `--all-targets` on each crate is ok.
- After the gate, one doc comment in `crates/app/src/schema.rs` changed (it names `InsertText` as a writer of `Sketch`). Then `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` and the suites `insert_text`, `mcp_dxf` and `sketch_project` ran again: all ok.
- The gate ran with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` and no `RUSTC_WRAPPER`. With sccache, each compile stopped with no progress on this machine.

### Heavy lanes on the reviewed head

Head: `c8734b4492a81a136b66845a2dc0c39626ce407c`.
Heavy diff-selection base: `upstream/main` at `495ef74789b06f9aeaab09a18dd08c9b8ef06a20`.
The tests ran on the unmerged PR head.

Command: `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`.

The gate passed: exit 0, 217 steps, 0 failed steps, 27.5 minutes.
The release prebuild passed.

| Lane | Target steps | Tests passed | Expected failures (#1950) | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Motion | 33 | 56 | 2 | 0 |
| App | 183 | 42 | 1 | 0 |

The dedicated checks confirmed the three expected failures. The gate counted those checks as OK.
These failures are separate from the tests that passed.

### Latest quick gate rerun

Head remains `c8734b4492a81a136b66845a2dc0c39626ce407c`.

Command: `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`.

The quick diff-selection base was `upstream/main`. Its hash was not recorded separately.
The tests ran on the unmerged PR head.

The latest rerun finished with exit 1: 936 steps, 933 passed steps, 3 failed steps, 71.8 minutes.
All non-UI suites passed. The three failed steps have the same graphics limitations reported in the latest review:

- UI `lib`: 7 tests could not obtain a graphics adapter.
- UI `egui_app`: 3 tests returned exit code 1 instead of 0.
- UI `shell`: 1 test returned exit code 1 instead of 0.

The gate ran `clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` successfully for all eight crates.
This includes the touched crates `camcraft-geometry` and `camcraft-app`.

No source changed. The finding requested gate evidence only, so no new pin or mutation check was needed.
The earlier gate results above describe the original author run. This section records the latest rerun.

## Goldens moved

None. No `.nc` file and no `.cl` file changes. No snapshot PNG changes.

## Not exercised

- No toolpath, no verify and no posted G-code from a text profile. Generation from profile chains is refused by name on `main` until #1869.
- No UI. There is no dialog and no viewport placement in this PR. The command and the MCP tool are the only doors.
- No script verb `cam.insertText`. Follow-up: #2891 (`MCP: InsertText`).
- Placement on a model face. A `Sketch` lies on the top face of the stock only.

## Open work for #2679 after this PR

- The Engrave toolpath, verify, post and golden CL on a text profile (needs #1869).
- The UI: type the text, pick the spot, set the height.
- The text as an editable parameter (needs a schema field and a project version step).
- Lower-case glyphs and an outline font source, if the maintainer wants them.
- The refusals for a text profile say "DXF profile". The wording is shared with DXF profiles and with PR #2716.
- #2891 (`MCP: InsertText`) tracks the script verb `cam.insertText` and the `insert_text` row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`.

## Overlaps

- PR #2773 changes `ImportDxf::build` and `sketch::face_frame` / `sketch::stock_face`. This PR calls `sketch::face_frame` and does not change it. The files are different. After #2773 merges, `InsertText` can use `stock_face` for the named refusal of a stock with no flat top.
- PR #2716 changes `sketch_model.rs` and the operation code. This PR does not touch those files.
- PR #2678 adds lines to `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs` and `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` (different lines; the PR that merges second refreshes).
- The branch starts at `e048b103c`, and the gate ran on that base. `main` moved to `c4ac3ce6d` during the gate (#2149 and others merged). `git merge-tree upstream/main HEAD` gives no conflict.

Effort: high

Changelog: Typed text can be placed as single-line engraving strokes on the stock top (`InsertText`, MCP `insert_text`); the toolpath follows with Engrave on sketch chains (#1869).

Refs #2679
